question: How was the placement of Ratiśekhara transmitted in the Śrīpūrva tradition?
premises: Ratiśekhara is to be installed beforehand in the respective place according to what is worshipped.
This procedure was expounded in the Śrīpūrva scripture.
The teaching was transmitted to the author as a tradition.
inference: The author presents the prior installation of Ratiśekhara in its proper place as a received teaching from the Śrīpūrva tradition.
plain_english: Ratiśekhara is to be installed beforehand in the place appropriate to what is being worshipped. This is how the tradition was set forth to me in the Śrīpūrva scripture.
